description: This file defines classes and structs related to cgroup memory and processor information, including CGroupMemoryInfo, CGroupProcessorInfo, and CGroupMetrics, used for collecting cgroup metrics in a Linux environment.

classes.name: CGroupMemoryInfo
classes.description: Represents memory information for a cgroup, including allocated, resident, and shared memory.

classes.name: CGroupProcessorInfo
classes.description: Represents CPU usage information for a cgroup, including per-core usage and total usage.

classes.name: CGroupMetrics
classes.description: Helper class to collect cgroup metrics such as memory and CPU info.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage details from cgroup files.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Retrieves CPU core usage details from cgroup files.
